name: Link pages and campaigns

requirements.text: An account owner can create, update, and delete a link page with unique slug, content, and publish state.
A page has ordered active outbound items with validated HTTP(S) destinations.
Page-view and item-click events require consent and never store raw IP data.
A page attaches zero to five reusable active account-owned pixels.
Template selection uses defined supported templates, preview semantics, and migration behavior.
Custom CSS remains excluded unless a safe isolation and CSP design is approved.
Forms and lead capture require approved field schema, consent, retention, and access rules.
Workspace-owned images and PDFs are delivered only from unexpired, eligible blocks on published pages; PDFs require a clean malware scan and attachment-only delivery.
A/B experiments require deterministic assignment, reporting, and consent rules.
Link pages use validated button, text, image, form, and file blocks with standard, profile, and campaign templates.
Lead values are encrypted, owner/admin-only, consent-backed, exportable, and permanently purged after 30 days.
Weighted variants use one control and an opaque 30-day functional assignment cookie.

externalPrerequisites: Configured durable private media storage through LINKPILOT_MEDIA_DISK
Real ClamAV executable configured through CLAMSCAN_PATH for PDF scanning
Published privacy-policy URL configured through PUBLIC_PRIVACY_URL before production lead capture

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unpublished pages and unavailable blocks do not render or redirect.
Every outbound URL passes the first-party destination guard.
Lead submission requires explicit consent and values expire after 30 days.

Media URLs return 404 unless attached to an unexpired, active, in-window block on a published page; deactivation, schedule expiry, deletion, page unpublishing, or media expiry revokes delivery immediately. PDFs require a clean scan and are attachment-only.
Uploads cannot select a client-supplied media ID, disk, or path; media is workspace-owned, and foreign or unpublished assets return 404.

observedBehaviors: Link pages are listed as resource rows with status and action controls.
A create action and list toolbar are visible.

implementationEvidence.description: Link-page item destinations accept only HTTP(S) and reject default aliases plus claimed custom hosts in pending_dns, active, and failed states.
implementationEvidence.reference: tests/Feature/LinkPages/LinkPageTest.php; tests/Feature/Links/LinkManagementTest.php; php artisan test (168 tests, 10,347 assertions)

implementationEvidence.description: A zero-page quota account retained the create dialog and rendered its form-level plan limit.

Task 6 focused media/block tests passed 11 tests and 176 assertions; the full Laravel suite passed 407 tests and 14,519 assertions. One real-ClamAV PDF delivery test was skipped. Coverage includes guarded inline images, unreadable-stream 404, media lifecycle revocation, foreign-media isolation, client-ID rejection, and fail-closed scanner behavior.

At 390x844, a PNG rejected by the media service displayed its security-check error and aria-invalid state. The PDF upload surface was present; without real ClamAV, PDF upload failed closed. The public image delivered inline and the page had no horizontal overflow.

The isolated Laravel suite passed 428 tests and 15,151 assertions; one successful PDF-delivery test was skipped because ClamAV is unavailable. Phase 6 migration probes preserved representative legacy content/events and passed SQLite integrity and foreign-key checks.

At 390px, the editor showed templates, mixed blocks, lead forms, and variants without horizontal overflow; PDF upload failed closed without ClamAV. Workspace admins opened leads at 390px and 1440px; a nonmember platform admin received 404 for leads and private image preview.

Current Task 3 publishing/media suites passed inside the focused run, including blocks/templates, encrypted leads and retention, deterministic variants, migration preservation, private image delivery, and fail-closed PDF handling; the clean-PDF case remained conditionally skipped without ClamAV.
implementationEvidence.reference: tests/Feature/LinkPages; tests/Feature/Content; Task 3 focused run (363 passed, 1 skipped, 4166 assertions)

implementationEvidence.description: Managed Chromium captured the populated desktop link-page list and responsive mobile surface with no HTTP/page errors or horizontal overflow.
